content: Usage of DataPrototypeTransformationProps in case of a VariableDataPrototype If a VariableDataPrototype is transported in the ISignal the DataPrototypeTransformationProps can be used to assign SOMEIPTransformationProps to a DataPrototype that is or is part of the Vari- ableDataPrototype .
